headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI‑related wins.
summary: Revenue rose across the major players, with TCS posting ₹73,188 cr and a 24% margin. HCLTech highlighted AI sales as a key driver and posted a 21% profit rise. Mid‑tier firms such as LTM and Tech Mahindra also delivered double‑digit top‑line growth. Persistent reported a sharp profit decline, marking the sector's weakest performance.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI services contributed to higher margins and profit growth at several firms.
